hook_text: Gold, coal, diamonds and a golden rhino, all in one minute.
clip_script: Kimberley, revision day. Table 1: minerals are non-renewable. Gold never rusts, diamonds are hardest, coal makes electricity. Towns grew around mines. Strip, open pit and deep shafts. Table 2: acid mine water, dust and smoke, waste and rehabilitation. Hot, deep mines and safety gear. Table 3: the heritage trail. The Cradle, Mapungubwe's golden rhino, the Castle, the healing aloe and Drakensberg rock art. That is Term 4!
visual_style: Whiteboard rock samples and a mine, then a hard hat and an orange stream, then a passport stamped with five heritage icons.
mood: Upbeat and proud, like a final celebration of the year.
pacing: Fast and clear, one table at a time.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and test yourself with the Term 4 word banks.
